judged_text: No check against seatsPerTimeSlot for seated events, so guest additions can exceed available seats

record.issue_text: No check against seatsPerTimeSlot for seated events, so guest additions can exceed available seats

adjudication.rationale: The new `addGuestsHandler` unconditionally appends new attendees via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})` after only filtering duplicates/blacklist, and never checks `booking.eventType?.seatsPerTimeSlot` (which is included on the constructed `CalendarEvent` as `seatsPerTimeSlot`). For event types using seat limits, this allows adding guests beyond available seats because no capacity validation exists in the added code path.
